class.name: SteamLeaderboards
class.brief_description: Finds and reads leaderboards for the current Steam app.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.leaderboards]. Board handles and pending operations belong to this client scope.

method.name: find
method.description: Looks up an existing leaderboard by its Steam API [param name]. On success, the typed result contains a [SteamLeaderboard]. An unknown board returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: find_or_create
method.description: Looks up a board by its Steam API [param name], or creates it using [param sort] and [param display]. An existing board keeps its configured settings. On success, the typed result contains the board.

method.name: friends
method.description: Looks up the existing board and fetches up to [param count] rows from the signed-in account's friends view. The count must be between 1 and 100. Use [code]await[/code] to receive a [SteamLeaderboardPageResult].

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active scope exposes Steam leaderboards on the main thread.

method.name: query
method.description: Returns a branchable read for the existing Steam board named [param board_name]. Defaults to the first ten global ranks. Use [method SteamLeaderboardQuery.fetch] or [method SteamLeaderboardQuery.fetch_operation] to start the read.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits the signed 32-bit score to an existing board using keep-best. Use [code]await[/code] to receive a [SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult]. To supply details or a replay, start with [method with_details] or [method with_replay].

method.name: top
method.description: Looks up [param board_name] and fetches the first [param count] global ranks. The count must be between 1 and 100. Use [code]await[/code] to receive a [SteamLeaderboardPageResult]. See [method query] for other rank ranges and cancellable queries.

method.name: with_details
method.description: Starts score options with these game-defined details. A submission accepts at most 64 signed 32-bit integers.

method.name: with_replay
method.description: Starts score options with a requested replay attachment. Pass a nonzero decimal Steam Remote Storage handle belonging to the active app.

constants.constant: Displays scores as plain signed numbers.
Displays scores as durations in seconds.
Displays scores as durations in milliseconds.
